title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in Commerce or Science stream.
overview: Comprehensive program covering Accounting, Corporate Finance, Taxation, Auditing, and Business Law.

title: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PU Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics / Biology subjects.
overview: Discipline-specific combinations in Physical, Chemical, Life, and Mathematical Sciences.

title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PU Examination with Mathematics / Computer Science / Accountancy.
overview: Industry-aligned IT education covering Software Development, Database Systems, Cloud Computing, and Web Technologies.

title: Bachelor of Arts (BA)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in any stream.
overview: Multidisciplinary humanities education in Literature, Economics, History, Political Science, Sociology, and Journalism.

title: Bachelor of Social Work (BSW)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / Pre-University Examination in any discipline.
overview: Professional social work training emphasizing community organization, field work, human rights, and social development.

title: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PU Examination with minimum 45% aggregate marks.
overview: Focuses on Management Principles, Marketing, Human Resources, Financial Analysis, and Entrepreneurship.

title: BBA Tourism & Hospitality Management
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PU Examination in any discipline.
overview: Specialized degree in Travel Operations, Hotel Management, Event Operations, and International Tourism.

title: Bachelor of Vocation (B.Voc)
eligibility: Pass in 10+2 / PU Examination or NSQF Level 4 certification.
overview: Skill-intensive vocational degrees in Information Technology and Digital Media Production.

title: Department of Languages & Literature
overview: Language foundation and elective literature courses in English, Kannada, Hindi, French, Malayalam, and Urdu.
